egress.terms: Download (ingress to slot) unlimited. Upload (egress from slot) metered 10 TB on H3-4 up to 40 TB on H3-22. FAQ verbatim: "We will limit your upload speed to 100 Megabits per second until your next billing cycle" on overage.

chaining: Good archive target, poor fetch target: the capped direction is exactly the serving direction
limits_note: Upload byte cap; over-cap = 100 Mbps throttle, not a bill
reliability_note: Operating since 2008 in Singapore, Netherlands, and United States locations. Marketing describes unmetered inbound downloads, while outbound upload traffic is metered.

evidence.proved: overage throttle to 100 Megabits + 'Downloading files to your slot's hard drive is completely unlimited'

extras.agent_focus: Wave 7 cheap-paid lane: seedboxes and storage-specific hosts as bulk storage (not seeding). Price floor per TB-month with free/unmetered egress. Feral, Ultra.cc, Whatbox, PulsedMedia, SeedHost.eu, Bytesized, Seedbox.io/HostingByDesign, Hostsailor, RapidSeedbox, Dediseedbox, Xirvik, plus storage-only rsync.net, BorgBase, Tuxis, Greenhost, Njalla, Hetzner Storage Share/Box, Icedrive, FileLu.

binding_note: one stream is shaped, and aggregate throughput is the shaped rate times the number of streams
